evidence.artifact: android-4.4.4_r2 Canvas.drawBitmap(Bitmap,float,float,Paint) calls native_drawBitmap. With matching densities and a null Paint, SkCanvasGlue draws with canvas->drawBitmap(*bitmap, left, top, paint). BitmapFactory.decodeResource opens the raw resource and decodes pixels. SurfaceHolder.lockCanvas returns a Canvas bound to the holder Surface.

host_adaptation: DEX Bitmap objects map to host agr_bitmap instances by object identity. Pixels are KitKat SkImageDecoder output in SkPMColor RGBA byte order. Index8 GIF frames expand to ARGB_8888 without linking SkCanvas. JPEG fill_below_level writes white rows without SkCanvas. agr_bitmap_draw performs clipped SRC_OVER onto the locked content Surface backing. The host surface mutex is not held across the blit beyond the existing canvas_locked ownership.
